module.purpose: Implements the temporary select-tool state that lets users drag a freeform scribble across shapes to select them, while supporting modifier-key selection semantics, visual scribble feedback, completion, and cancellation.
module.summary: This state node manages a freeform brushing interaction within the selection tool. It records the selection present when brushing begins, renders the pointer path as a scribble, incrementally hit-tests candidate shapes against each movement segment, respects groups, locked shapes, frame containment, masks, and modifier keys, then commits or restores selection when the interaction completes or is cancelled.
module.businessContext: Supports freeform shape selection in the drawing editor. If it fails, users cannot reliably select multiple irregularly arranged shapes or restore selection after cancelling a brush gesture.

units.name: ScribbleBrushing

detail.name: ScribbleBrushing
detail.summary: Represents the selection-tool state used while the user selects shapes by drawing a scribble. It exposes the state metadata and selection-tracking fields required by the state machine.

specLiterals.role: Static state-node identifier used to bind this class to the scribble-brushing state.

units.name: onEnter

detail.name: onEnter
preconditions: The editor and its scribbles collection are available.
The method is entered as part of the ScribbleBrushing state lifecycle.
postconditions: initialSelectedShapeIds contains the shape IDs selected when entry began.
A scribble with color selection-stroke, opacity 0.32, and size 12 is added.
scribbleId is set to the newly added scribble's ID.
The editor instance brush state is set to null.
invariants: The initial selection is captured independently of whether shift is held.
The captured initial selection is stored as a Set of shape IDs.
edgeCases: When no shapes are selected, initialSelectedShapeIds is an empty set and entry still creates the scribble and clears the brush state.
When shapes are already selected, the exact selection at entry is captured before scribble selection is updated.
Any exception raised by the editor selection query, scribble creation, selection update, or instance-state update is not handled by this method.
stateMutations: Replaces initialSelectedShapeIds with a new Set containing the editor's selected shape IDs.
Replaces newlySelectedShapeIds with an empty Set.
Sets scribbleId to the ID returned by editor.scribbles.addScribble.
Updates the editor instance state to set brush to null.
detail.ioFormatSpec: Adds a scribble using { color: 'selection-stroke', opacity: 0.32, size: 12 } and updates editor instance state with { brush: null }.
detail.summary: Initializes a scribble-brushing interaction from the current selection state and creates the visual scribble indicator. It resets brush-tracking state, updates scribble selection, and clears the instance brush state.

specLiterals.role: Color identifier used for the created selection scribble.
Opacity of the created selection scribble.
Size of the created selection scribble.
Reset value for the brushing size.

specTests.then: The current selection is captured, newlySelectedShapeIds is reset to empty, size is zero, hits is cleared, a scribble is created with color 'selection-stroke', opacity 0.32, and size 12, the returned scribble ID is stored, and the editor brush state becomes null.

units.name: onKeyUp

detail.name: onKeyUp
postconditions: If Alt is not held, the parent state transitions to "brushing".
If Alt is held, the scribble selection is updated with the non-initial update flag.
invariants: The active behavior is selected solely from the current Alt-key state at key-up time.
edgeCases: When Alt is not held, no scribble-selection update is performed and the parent transitions to "brushing".
When Alt remains held, no parent transition is performed and the scribble selection is updated with false.
detail.summary: Handles key-release input while scribble brushing, returning to ordinary brushing when Alt is no longer held and otherwise refreshing the scribble selection.

specTests.then: The parent transitions to the "brushing" state, and the scribble selection is not updated.
updateScribbleSelection(false) is invoked, and the parent does not transition.

units.name: updateScribbleSelection

detail.name: updateScribbleSelection
preconditions: The ScribbleBrushing instance has initialized editor input state and selection tracking sets.
The editor can provide the origin, previous, and current page points for the active scribble.
postconditions: If addPoint is true, the current scribble point has been appended through pushPointToScribble().
Shapes hit by the current pointer segment and eligible for selection are added to newlySelectedShapeIds through their outermost selectable shape.
The editor selection is updated only when the computed selection differs from the current selection.
Without shift, the resulting selection consists of newly selected shape IDs; with shift, initial selected shape IDs are retained as well.
invariants: Groups are never directly added to the newly selected set.
Shapes already present in newlySelectedShapeIds are not processed again.
Locked shapes are skipped unless editor.options.selectLockedShapes is enabled.
A frame-like shape containing the scribble origin in its shape-space bounds is not selected.
A shape with a mask is selected only when the segment-mask intersection rules permit the current point.
Selection ordering is based on insertion order into the computed set.
edgeCases: When addPoint is false, no scribble point is appended, but selection processing still occurs.
When the segment's candidate shape ID set is empty, expensive rendering-shape retrieval is skipped and the selection is still synchronized from the tracked selected IDs.
When a candidate is a group, already newly selected, or locked while locked selection is disabled, it is ignored.
When a shape lacks geometry or a page transform, it is ignored.
When the segment lies entirely outside a shape's geometry bounds, line-segment hit testing is skipped.
When a masked shape's segment intersects its mask but the current page point is outside the mask, the shape is ignored.
When the computed selection already equals the editor's current selection, setSelectedShapes is not called.
stateMutations: May append the current point to the scribble state through pushPointToScribble().
Mutates newlySelectedShapeIds by adding eligible outermost selectable shape IDs.
May mutate the editor's selected shape IDs through setSelectedShapes().
detail.summary: Updates the scribble-selection set using the current pointer segment and editor shape geometry. It optionally records the current scribble point and synchronizes selected shapes while respecting shift-selection, groups, locks, frames, masks, and hit testing.

specTests.then: No rendering-shape retrieval occurs, and the editor selection is set to the newly selected shape IDs only.
The current scribble point is appended and the shape's outermost selectable shape ID is added to the tracked newly selected set.
The tracked set may be processed, but editor.setSelectedShapes is not called.
